Advanced 1 or 2 Channel Dante Amplifier with support for Low and High Impedance Speaker Systems

The AMP-2120-DNT is a compact, professional-grade amplifier designed for maximum flexibility in modern AV environments. Supporting both 70V/100V high-impedance or 4/8Ω low-impedance speaker loads, it delivers up to 240W of power in mono or 2x120W in stereo. Built-in DSP provides advanced audio processing—including gain, EQ, filters, dynamics, delay, and mixing—ensuring crystal-clear speech and optimized playback for any application. With flexible analog inputs, Dante connectivity, and intuitive control options via front panel, TCP/IP, or web GUI, the AMP-2120-DNT integrates seamlessly into classrooms, conference rooms, and multipurpose spaces. Automatic paging mute, security features, and comprehensive status indicators make it reliable for both critical communication and everyday use. Compact at just 0.5U, it offers powerful performance and versatility in a space-saving form factor.

The AMP-260-DNT supports both local line-level and remote Dante audio inputs, allowing for a wide range of audio sources to be connected. This flexibility ensures that the amplifier can seamlessly integrate into any existing AV infrastructure, providing high-quality audio distribution across different zones.

Built-in DSP provides comprehensive audio control: including mic gain (0–60 dB) and line gain (±20 dB), up to 10-band parametric EQ, dynamic control, filters, limiter, delay, output limiter. full matrix mixer — all without a separate processor.

Equipped with a comprehensive digital signal processor (DSP), this amplifier offers extensive audio customization options including gain control, a limiter, five-band EQ, and up to 200ms of delay. These features enable users to fine-tune the audio output to match the specific requirements of the environment, ensuring an optimal listening experience.

Features flexible analog audio connections, including 2× Mic inputs (each with individually switchable 48V phantom power, or 1x Line input), 1× Line input, 1× Line output. 1× amplifier output (Hi-Z or Low-Z switchable).

With the capability to be powered either by a DC 24V 5A power supply or via PoE+, the AMP-260-DNT offers unmatched operational flexibility. This dual power supply feature ensures that the amplifier can be easily installed and powered in a variety of settings, making it a versatile choice for different professional AV applications.
Integrated 2×2 Dante audio networking enables seamless audio distribution, decoding, and encoding with support for up to 96kHz sample rates for professional networked audio environments.

The amplifier is designed with user convenience in mind, featuring front panel volume controls and LED status indicators for easy operation. Moreover, it adheres to CA SB-327 compliance for secure web UI login controls, ensuring that system settings are protected and can be safely managed either locally or remotely.
